Accuracy & privacy

Calorie targets are estimates, not medical advice. Packaged-food data comes from the community-maintained Open Food Facts database and may be incomplete or incorrect. Compare entries with the product label.

No profile or diary information is uploaded by BiteLog in this prototype. Food searches and barcode numbers are sent to Open Food Facts.
